A regular expression that matches the topics that the module
will allow access to. The module will grant access only to
topics that match this regular expression and do not match
the DeniedTopics regular expression.
Defaults to .*, matching all topics in the instance.

A regular expression that matches the topics that the module
will deny access to. The module will grant access only to
topics that do not match this regular expression.
There is no default for this parameter. If not provided, the
module does not consider any topics to be explicitly denied
and will grant access to any topic that matches the
AllowedTopics parameter.

When set, this option directs the module to grant only read or
write permissions when a topic is allowed.
This option accepts a value of read or write, specifying
which permission the module will grant.
There is no default for this parameter. If not provided, the
module will grant both read and write permissions to any
allowed topic.
When using this option for the Admin transport, notice that
the administrator actions use an HTTP GET, so they are
considered read operations.
